name: ProTreck
desc: Outdoor watch with 5 tabs: ASTRO (clock, 3 alarms, sun arc + civil twilight, moon phase disc), CMPAS (compass rose, waypoint bearing/distance), CHRONO, TIMER, ALTI (altitude, déniv+/−, climb rate, trend graph). Status bar with local time, GPS and battery on every tab. Contributed by samuelcoustet.
